label: Midnight Celestial Fusion
tasteProfile: A retro-futuristic cinematic aesthetic defined by the collision of warm mustard-yellow accents against deep, cool blue lighting. Heavy film grain lends a nostalgic analog feel; abstract light beams cut through hazy darkness, adding depth and quiet motion. Balanced, centered compositions with sharp focal clarity against soft atmospheric backgrounds. The mood is mysterious and contemplative, like a still from a lost 1980s science-fiction film.

label: Rough Cut Revival
tasteProfile: This aesthetic converges raw, high-contrast linocut techniques with a bold, muted color scheme characterized by acidic to earthy greens. It combines the edgy, DIY spirit of punk-zine visuals with the tactile, artisanal quality of hand-carved textures. The emphasis is on striking graphic silhouettes and deliberate, handmade imperfections, evoking a sense of rough-hewn, organic printmaking.
